verdict.rationale: Browser Use is an open-source Python library (github.com/browser-use/browser-use) that AI-native users can install and run themselves locally, distinct from the paid cloud API, and community evidence confirms users run it locally with their own browser/profile. missing for 10: no first-party self-hosting guide for a full server/infra deployment (only local pip/library install is evidenced), no independent report of hosting it as a persistent service.
